dedupe_keys.name: idb digilac broadband and digital development indicators for latin america and the caribbean 31 268 indicator values 2012 2021 and the idba broadband development index 2010 2015

description: DigiLAC is the IDB platform on broadband and digital development in Latin America and the Caribbean, and its indicator table is published on IDB Open Data alongside the earlier Broadband Development Index (IDBA). Contents: 31,268 values in long format (indicator code, country ISO code, year, real value and normalised value) covering digital infrastructure (fixed and mobile broadband penetration, coverage, speeds, prices), applications and capacity, regulation and policy pillars; the separate IDBA file (2.8 MB CSV) scores 26 IDB member countries and 38 reference countries on 37 indicators in four pillars for 2010 to 2015. Producer: IDB Connectivity, Markets and Finance Division, compiling ITU, GSMA and other international sources. Coverage: Latin America and the Caribbean with global comparators, 2012 to 2021. Format and access: CSV files with DOIs and a CKAN datastore API; no registration. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO. Caveats: indicator codes need the platform's documentation to decode, values are national aggregates, and sources differ across years. Simulation uses: setting national broadband penetration and quality parameters for digital infrastructure investment and demand models, and benchmarking connectivity in resilience studies. Related records: the ITU and national telecom regulator records in the catalogue give underlying operator statistics.
